articles.title: NASA CSDA Announces 8 New Commercial Satellite Data Agreements
articles.summary: NASA's Commercial Satellite Data Acquisition program announced partnerships with Planet, Airbus, Vantor, Capella, ICEYE, MDA, and Umbra, expanding high-quality multispectral and SAR data access for Earth science research.
articles.significance: Major expansion of commercial satellite data access for NASA research community

articles.title: Deep Learning Pipeline Reconstructs Century of Urban Growth from Historical Imagery
articles.summary: New deep learning pipeline uses attention-enhanced Pix2Pix colorization and U-Net++ segmentation to bridge century-scale domain gap, enabling automated urban expansion reconstruction from 1920-2024 aerial and satellite imagery.
articles.significance: Breakthrough allows quantitative urban reconstruction from pre-satellite archives

articles.title: Quantum LiDAR Breakthrough Achieves 1000-Fold SNR Improvement
articles.summary: Revolutionary quantum lidar system fundamentally redefines covert 3D sensing capabilities with astonishing 1000-fold improvement in Signal-to-Noise Ratio over classical devices.
articles.significance: Game-changing advancement in LiDAR sensitivity and covert sensing capabilities

articles.title: Mohammed VI Satellites Achieve Sub-0.5m Accuracy for Large-Scale Mapping
articles.summary: Morocco's Mohammed VI satellites demonstrate planimetric RMSE under 0.5 meters, meeting 1:10,000 mapping standards and proving very-high-resolution satellite imagery as cost-effective alternative to aerial photogrammetry.
articles.significance: Validates satellite imagery for national topographic mapping programs at unprecedented precision

articles.title: NASA-ESA-USGS Release Joint Earth Observation Quality Assessment Framework
articles.summary: Joint Earth Observation Mission Quality Assessment Framework provides standardized methodology for assessing optical data quality from commercial Earth observation missions, supporting trusted use of commercial EO data.
articles.significance: Establishes industry standards for commercial Earth observation data quality assessment

articles.title: Deep Learning Pipeline Detects Rip Currents from Satellite Imagery
articles.summary: New deep learning pipeline successfully detects rip currents from high-resolution satellite imagery using object detection and classification models, providing high-accuracy offline analysis tool for coastal hazard assessment.
articles.significance: First automated satellite-based rip current detection system for coastal safety applications
